title: doctor accepts `gh auth token` as a GitHub credential, but run-epic's surface reads GITHUB_TOKEN only
description:
doctor's github check reports ok when `gh auth token` answers, but the PR + CI close-out surface run-epic builds (pullRequestsForRun -> forge.ResolveToken) reads GITHUB_TOKEN only. On a repo whose close-out rule init declares, a machine with gh authed but no GITHUB_TOKEN passes doctor and is still refused by run-epic at startup. Tick 9sz's `ticfac run` is planned to fetch the token from gh, which closes the gap; until then doctor's ok is optimistic, and either doctor should name which source it found or run-epic should accept gh's answer.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 8121b4f7c18b47c7dc2b2c6d045dc14eaf93ee37006371522340dd71175642c6 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-o0d/attempt-3): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates the done, naming no single item (the fallback names every item at risk in its reason). The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/8121b4f7c18b47c7dc2b2c6d045dc14eaf93ee37006371522340dd71175642c6.json on the run branch.
